Items.Rationale: Multi-digit arithmetic/estimation, place value, equivalent/comparison fractions, measurement conversions or multiplicative reasoning.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: قدّر ناتج جمع 198 و304 بتقريب كل عدد إلى أقرب مئة أولاً.
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: Estimate 198 + 304 by first rounding each number to the nearest hundred.
Items.Rationale: Whole-number multiplication/division, unknown-number equations, equal-part fractions, area/perimeter or whole-number measurement.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: ما العدد المكوّن من 4 آلاف و3 مئات و2 عشرات و7 آحاد؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: Which number has four thousands, three hundreds, two tens, and seven ones?
Items.Rationale: Multi-digit arithmetic/estimation, place value, equivalent/comparison fractions, measurement conversions or multiplicative reasoning.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: إذا انتقل الرقم 4 من منزلة المئات إلى منزلة الآلاف، كم مرة تصبح قيمته المكانية أكبر؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: If the digit 4 moves from the hundreds place to the thousands place, by what factor does its place value increase?
Items.Rationale: Multi-digit arithmetic/estimation, place value, equivalent/comparison fractions, measurement conversions or multiplicative reasoning.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: ما العدد الذي يساوي ستة آلاف وأربع عشرات وتسعة آحاد، دون إضافة مئات؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: Which number represents six thousands, four tens and nine ones, with zero hundreds?
Items.Rationale: Multi-digit arithmetic/estimation, place value, equivalent/comparison fractions, measurement conversions or multiplicative reasoning.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: على خط الأعداد توجد علامتان عند 340 و360. ما العدد الواقع في منتصف المسافة بينهما؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: On a number line, two marks are at 340 and 360. What number is exactly halfway between them?
Items.Rationale: Whole-number multiplication/division, unknown-number equations, equal-part fractions, area/perimeter or whole-number measurement.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: أي عدد من الخيارات التالية يصبح 4600 عند تقريبه لأقرب مئة بالطريقة المعتادة؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: Which of these numbers rounds to 4,600 to the nearest hundred using the usual half-up rule?
Items.Rationale: Multi-digit arithmetic/estimation, place value, equivalent/comparison fractions, measurement conversions or multiplicative reasoning.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: مع النادي 1500 ليرة واشترى أدوات بمبالغ 490 و390 و610 ليرات. كم ليرة تبقّت؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: A club has 1,500 units of currency and buys supplies costing 490, 390 and 610. How much is left?
Items.Rationale: Multi-digit arithmetic/estimation, place value, equivalent/comparison fractions, measurement conversions or multiplicative reasoning.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: لدينا 36 قلماً. كوّنا أكبر عدد ممكن من حزم تحتوي كل منها عشرة أقلام. كم حزمة كاملة وكم قلماً متبقياً؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: There are 36 pencils. Make as many complete bundles of ten as possible. How many bundles and loose pencils remain?
Items.Rationale: Small whole-number subtraction, simple constant-step pattern or grouping tens and ones within 100.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: ما أصغر عدد مكوّن من أربعة أرقام يكون فيه الرقم 6 في المئات والرقم 8 في الآحاد؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: What is the smallest four-digit number with 6 in the hundreds place and 8 in the ones place?
Items.Rationale: Multi-digit arithmetic/estimation, place value, equivalent/comparison fractions, measurement conversions or multiplicative reasoning.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: كم عدد مضاعفات العدد عشرة الواقعة بين 365 و390 دون احتساب الطرفين؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: How many multiples of ten lie strictly between 365 and 390, excluding both endpoints?
Items.Rationale: Two- and three-digit arithmetic, repeated counting and basic length.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: كم عدد الأعداد الصحيحة من 200 إلى 299 التي يكون رقم العشرات فيها 4؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: How many integers from 200 through 299 have 4 in the tens place?
Items.Rationale: Two- and three-digit arithmetic, repeated counting and basic length.

Items.ExpectedQuestionAr: بدأ عدّاد عند 6,005 ثم نقص 90. ما العدد الجديد؟
Items.ExpectedQuestionEn: A counter starts at 6,005 and decreases by 90. What is the new value?
Items.Rationale: Multi-digit arithmetic/estimation, place value, equivalent/comparison fractions, measurement conversions or multiplicative reasoning.
